title: Women Are Sacred 2027:
headline: One job: make people mark October 5–7, 2027 in their calendar.
story: Pure announcement energy. Short, confident, building. This is the shortest of the five and the most music-driven. It runs next to NIWRC's own Save the Date post from 1 Oct.
Text is the star. The date is the whole point. NIWRC has now published it: October 5–7, 2027, Temecula, California. Put exactly that on screen.
do: Open on the single most energetic archive shot, hook text on frame 1.
Make the text big and high-contrast. Readable at thumbnail size.
Build the cuts faster toward the date.
Match NIWRC's 1 Oct Save the Date wording exactly.
Leave the last 2 s clean for a painless logo drop-in.
dont: No logo, title card or fade at 0:00.
No old WAS lockup (two women holding hands), even in the background.
No images of harm or fear. No red handprint. No statistics.
No day of the week. No date other than “October 5–7, 2027”.
No Durham footage. This one is the WAS archive only.
